allowed_before_lock: raw-file identities, checksums, sizes, and read counts
prohibited_before_lock: inspection of FNBP1 splice or junction evidence
changing the event, label rule, eligibility thresholds, or outcomes after seeing event evidence

dataset.chemistry: 10x Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3 prime v3.1
dataset.age_design: four youth (16-22 years) and four middle-aged adults (44-53 years)

event.coordinate_system: the fixed GRCh38/GENCODE v49 event used for D5
event.selection: fixed by the earlier federated discovery and D5 confirmation; no locus reselection is permitted

label_rule.scope: apply independently within each donor, preserving the D5 transformations and thresholds
label_rule.marker_standardization: within each donor, z-score each transformed marker over all donor nuclei and clip to [-3,3]
label_rule.submodule_score: mean marker z-score, then z-score that mean over all donor nuclei
label_rule.lineage_score: maximum of the lineage's two submodule scores
label_rule.assignment: select the highest lineage score when its selected submodule detects at least two markers, its score is at least 0.50, and its margin over the runner-up is at least 0.35
label_rule.ambiguous_or_doublet: the two best eligible lineages both score at least 0.50 and their score margin is below 0.35, or the nucleus is above the donor-specific 99.5th non-FNBP1 GEX-UMI percentile and the runner-up is eligible with score at least 0
label_rule.missing_or_unresolved: unresolved when the best lineage fails the marker-detection, score, or margin rule and does not meet the ambiguous/doublet rule
label_rule.fnbp1_exclusion: the counts row named FNBP1 must be skipped without parsing; FNBP1 is absent from every marker module and excluded from each library-size denominator

PASS: all eight donor identities remain distinct in metadata and sequence manifests
at least four donors have at least 1000 published-QC nuclei
every locked marker is present in the processed gene table
at least four donors receive at least 50 microglia_immune labels under the frozen rule
the public paired FASTQ manifest has complete MD5 identities for every run
feasibility_gate.STOP: if any PASS condition fails, do not download or query raw sequence evidence; report the gate as underpowered

outcome_gate.event_counting: deduplicate by donor, cell barcode, and UMI; report include_only, exclude_only, both, informative cells, and conservative usage per donor and frozen broad group

primary_brain_replication.eligible_donor: at least 10 informative event molecules across all called nuclei
primary_brain_replication.PASS: at least 75% of eligible donors have conservative inclusion usage above 0.50 and the median donor usage is at least 0.75
primary_brain_replication.FAIL: the analysis is not stopped and the PASS rule is not met

microglia_localization.eligible_donor: at least four informative microglia_immune molecules and at least ten informative molecules among all other resolved groups
microglia_localization.STOP: fewer than six eligible donors; with four or five donors the smallest possible two-sided exact sign-test p-value exceeds 0.05, so report exact counts only and make no compartment-effect claim
microglia_localization.estimand: within-donor conservative-usage difference, microglia_immune minus all other resolved groups
microglia_localization.PASS: at least 75% of eligible donors have a negative difference and the two-sided exact sign-test p-value is at most 0.05
microglia_localization.FAIL: the analysis is not stopped and the PASS rule is not met

outcome_gate.age_analysis: not an outcome; report donor ages only and do not test or stratify the fixed event by age
claims_forbidden: generalization outside the sampled SEZ tissue
